morning.caption:
Two Ohio villages, 2,150 MW of new gas-fired power, all of it for data centers. On November 19 the state siting board permitted an 800 MW plant in Ashville and a 1,350 MW plant in Millersport.

Rockies Express is lining up the gas, with binding bids due Tuesday on a lateral of up to 175,000 Dth/d near Ashville.

midday.caption:
What does a refiner pay to borrow for a big acquisition right now? For CVR Energy, 9.25%. It priced $1.25 billion of secured notes due 2032 to help buy Marathon's St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries.

evening.caption:
Iranian lawmakers say tankers are getting ready to break the US naval blockade, though Tehran has announced no plan. Kpler counts about 20 tankers near Kharg Island and sees Iran's crude export revenue reaching zero by mid-December.

Meanwhile, attacks around Hormuz in October and November were the most of any months since the war began, according to UKMTO and IMO data.
